statement: With re-attach on, F6 mirror off and calibration copy on, Dolphin re-sends 0x12 but repeatedly receives error 7 at F6. Raw post-map MP and child frames arrive, but decoded gyro and Nunchuk are not established and neither calibration read is reached. Native post-map A400F0=55 count is zero. Scope is virtual Original with hid-wiimote not bound, test/dev under #258; not game, radio, physical, release or Plus acceptance.

applicability.revision: Original / virtual Wii Remote PID 0306; physical revision unmeasured
applicability.scope: evidence_role: consumer. W9g native Dolphin 2503, generic-bound test/dev only under #258, imported caller synthetic calibration and specified independent compat flags. UI decoded oracle is separate from raw transport and frame counts. No Plus, Cemu, radio, physical, game or release acceptance.
